text.p: Fidelity Investments said it introduced on Tuesday six new Advisor funds, focusing on market sectors.
Fidelity said the funds include Fidelity Advisor Consumer Industries, Cyclical Industries, Financial Services, Health Care, Technology, and Utilities Growth.

Consumer Industries will be managed by Katherine Collins, who will continue to run the Select Leisure fund. Albert Ruback, who will continue to run the Select Financial Services Portfolio, will run the Cyclical Industries fund. Health Care will be managed by Karen Firestone, who will still run the Select Biotechnology Portfolio fund.
Financial Services will be managed by Louis Salemy, who runs Select Financial Services Portfolio fund. Adam Hetnarski, who runs the Select Technology Portfolio fund, adds the Advisor Technology fund.
Utilities will be run by John Muresianu, who will keep managing the Select Utilities Growth fund and the Utilities Fund.
At June 30, Fidelity had $452.3 billion in total managed assets.
